Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling westbound on a multi-lane arteiral in Sugar Land, Texas, and was turning left into a commercial
lot when the vehicle was struck on the driver side by Driver 2, who was proceeding straight through the intersection.
Driver 1 was operating a vehicle in which the Passenger was also seated. Responding officers observed that the
vehicle sustained front-end and driver-side damage that appears broadly consistent with the reported impact
sequence. Photographs taken at the scene support several of the details provided by both drivers. No independent
witnesses were located, and no statements could be obtained from anyone other than the parties involved. Both the
officer and the parties at the scene cnofirmed that the Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time of the collision.
Dirver 1 reported a wrist injury and was transported for evaluation, though it is not yet clear whether that injury
resulted from this crash. Records reviewed at the scene showed no prior damage to the vehicle. Driver 1 is listed as a
named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.

- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
